li.p: Select SettingsVehicleLightsInterior lights On on the infotainment system screen.

section.title: Operating condition(s)
section.p: The interior button lights turn on or off in the following conditions.

li.p: The interior button lights turn on for a while when the door is unlocked and opened under condition that all doors were closed and locked.
The interior button lights always turn on when the vehicle is turned on.
The interior button lights turn on for a while when the vehicle is turned off. If the door is opened and closed or locked, the interior button lights turnoff immediately.

note.p: The infotainment system may change after software updates. For more details, please refer to the web manual in the quick reference guide.
